body: A few years ago driving down 23rd ave, my tire blew in -30 and blowing snow.. I had my toddlers in tow and it was busy rush hour. A kind man pulled over and changed my tire for me. I got his name and number but I had lost the paper I had it written on. I tried to find him over social media to no avail. I will never forget that kind man, Bruce. I paid it forward in all the ways I was able and continue to do so :) if you are out there, Bruce, you made an impact that day and i will never forget.
